content: We train Word2Vec with vector size $d_\mathrm {W2V} = d_\mathrm {LM} = 768$ on PubMed+PMC (see Appendix for details). Then, we follow the procedure described in Section SECREF3 to update the wordpiece embedding layer and tokenizer of general-domain BERT.
